He pinned the note above his logbook, lit the evening lamp, and for the first time in years felt that the long nights had been witnessed by someone after all.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝的睡梦里。街灯把空荡的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，尾灯像流星一样消失在路口。早餐铺的窗口亮起第一盏灯，蒸笼里冒出白汽。清洁工推着扫帚，沙沙声在寂静中格外清晰。写字楼仍黑着，只有零星几扇窗亮着，像没合上的眼睛。天边泛起极淡的灰白，鸟还没醒，风却先一步穿过巷子。这是城市最诚实的时刻，褪去喧嚣，只剩呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem again and again.\n• Think of standing in a line: to find your spot, you ask the person in front, and they ask the person in front of them, until someone at the very front just knows.\n• It always needs a stopping point, or it would keep asking forever and never finish."}
